notes.title: Biorage: Price Decreased PERMANENTLY from 5 USD to 1 USD!
notes.content: [h1]Biorage will be 0.99 usd/euros from now on![/h1][p][/p][p]Hello there![/p][p][/p][p]Biorage has been out for a while now. I set the price initially to 5 USD.[/p][p][/p][p]After the initial wave of release and now the months have gone by, I think it's time for a permanent decrease.[/p][p][/p][p]As of now Biorage is available for 0.99 USD/euros.[/p][p][/p][p]little extra announcement: I will also be putting Biorage on itch.io later this week![/p][p][/p][p]That's all folks![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Biorage 1.1 UPDATE
notes.content: [p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]It's time for some biorage![/p][p][/p][p]The next few days, I'll be posting daily stuff about this game like sales, wishlists, opinions, speedrun strategy's etc as a sort of resurgence you might say.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyways today a quick little hotfix.[/p][p][/p][p]-- Tried to fix a shotgun bug that caused the game to crash after shooting it in chapter 1 level 3. (if it does still crash for some reason, a simple restart will 100 percent fix it)[/p][p][/p][p]-- Fixed the UI sprite for the "Random Mode" not appearing in the Extra Modes menu.[/p][p][/p][p]Update size: 47,6MB[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
